context.purpose: Transcribe a local PCM16 mono 16 kHz speech recording offline into checked millisecond segments, plain text, SRT and WebVTT. Optional caption review flags cue duration and density by fixed editorial thresholds, and an optional segmentation target asks whisper.cpp for shorter word-aware cues. Output is for human review.
context.assumptions: Absolute local WAV and ggml model paths, lowercase SHA-256 model pin, English or one explicit lowercase code from the 100 whisper.cpp 1.9.5 language codes (membership does not certify that the model is multilingual or recognises that language); latest stable whisper.cpp 1.9.5 whisper-cli executable.
context.constraints: PCM16 mono 16000 Hz, at most 600 seconds and 32MiB audio; model at most 4GiB; 2000 segments, 262144 characters; one CPU thread. No download, prompt, translation, diarisation, VAD, language detection or authored native flags; the only native option is the optional maxSegmentLength (16 to 200 code points, mapped to -ml N -sow), a target that long words and unspaced scripts can exceed, with experimental token-level cue timing. Accuracy is not certified. Caption review thresholds are editorial defaults, not standards, and are not authored.
context.inspection: Reopen captured audio and native JSON with strict closed parsing; independently check hashes, finite integral-millisecond timestamps, ordering, non-overlap and audio duration, then regenerate text/SRT/WebVTT byte-for-byte. Native SRT is compared with native JSON. The optional caption review is rebuilt from the checked segments and must match byte-for-byte after strict member and type checks. With maxSegmentLength, the argv must carry exactly the authored -ml N -sow, and segments.json records the target, enforced false and the host-counted cues over it; over-target cues are published, not refused.
context.recovery: INVALID_AUDIO_DATA: export PCM16 mono 16000 Hz WAV. AUDIO_RESOURCE_LIMIT: split audio. AUDIO_HASH_MISMATCH/MODEL_HASH_MISMATCH: restore the pinned bytes or update the pin deliberately. MODEL_CHANGED: do not modify the model during a run. TRANSCRIPT_EMPTY: no speech segments, nothing published. TRANSCRIPT_TIMING/TRANSCRIPT_INVALID: native output violated the contract (including a blank-looking or non-text cue); inspect native.json at the reported cue, then use cleaner audio or another pinned model. If maxSegmentLength was set, retry with it omitted or larger. INVALID_LANGUAGE at $.language: use one lowercase code from the schema enum (default en); full names, uppercase, auto and aliases are refused before any file is read. INVALID_ARGUMENT at $.arguments.maxSegmentLength: use a whole number from 16 to 200 or omit it. UNSUPPORTED_NATIVE_VERSION: configure whisper.cpp 1.9.5. VERIFICATION_FAILED on caption-review.json: the report differs from independent recomputation or exists without (or is missing despite) captionReview; rerun from the declared input.

With maxSegmentLength the segmentation member (target, enforced false, cue and over-target counts) is rebuilt from the checked segments and compared exactly; the cue length is never a pass/fail check.

context.purpose: Apply authored per-cue human text corrections, with a declared review status and note, to one retained whisper.cpp machine segments.json and publish a reviewed timed-text document, transcript text, SRT, WebVTT and an exact correction ledger. Host-only: whisper-cli is never launched.
context.assumptions: A retained unedited machine segments.json (schemaxis.whispercpp.segments/1) within the shared timed-text budgets, and its SHA-256 copied from the draft the author reviewed. Corrections are text replacements by cue index.
context.constraints: Host-only and not native-qualified: no audio, model or recognition run is read or repeated, there is no qualification record for this route, and a transcription receipt for the provider does not qualify it. At most 512 cues, 256 characters per cue and 32768 in total; at most 512 corrections; note 1 to 500 plain-text characters. No timing edits, splits, merges, insertions or deletions. The review status is the author's declaration; reviewer identity, hearing the audio, accuracy, readability and accessibility are not verified or certified.
context.inspection: Capture the draft bytes, require them to hash to basisSha256, then derive every publication again from those bytes and the authored edits and compare each file byte for byte: reviewed-segments.json (schemaxis.timedtext.reviewed/1, parsed by the shared validator), transcript.txt, captions.srt, captions.vtt, the corrections.json ledger and the optional caption-review.json recomputed on the corrected text. Membership is exact and any native launcher, submission or log is a failure.
context.recovery: CORRECTIONS_STALE: review the current draft and copy its sha256 into basisSha256. CORRECTION_INDEX_INVALID, CORRECTION_DUPLICATE, CORRECTION_NOOP, CORRECTION_TEXT_INVALID and CORRECTIONS_NOTE_INVALID name the entry to fix at its location. CORRECTIONS_STATUS_CONFLICT: use human-corrected with corrections or human-reviewed-unchanged without. DRAFT_NOT_MACHINE_DRAFT: correct the original machine draft, not a reviewed document. DRAFT_SOURCE_MISSING: the draft file or a directory on its path does not exist; INVALID_DRAFT_SOURCE: the path is relative, a link, a directory, not a regular file or over the byte budget. MISSING_ARGUMENT: add the absent required member. TIMED_TEXT_RESOURCE_LIMIT at $.corrections[n].text: shorten replacements so the corrected transcript stays within 32768 characters. UNKNOWN_ARGUMENT/INVALID_ARGUMENT: remove or fix the located member. TIMED_TEXT_*: the draft breaks the shared contract or budgets. VERIFICATION_FAILED: a retained file differs from independent replay; rerun from the declared input.

TIMING_NOOP: remove the entry equal to the existing interval. TIMING_OVERLAP and TIMING_AFTER_AUDIO name the offending edit: adjust it or its neighbour so the finished cues are ordered, nonoverlapping and inside the audio. TIMING_INDEX_INVALID, DELETION_INDEX_INVALID and CORRECTION_INDEX_INVALID: use a source index of the draft. CORRECTIONS_STATUS_CONFLICT: use human-corrected with at least one replacement, deletion or timing edit, or human-reviewed-unchanged with none. DRAFT_SOURCE_MISSING: the draft file or a directory on its path does not exist; INVALID_DRAFT_SOURCE: the path is relative, a link, a directory, not a regular file or over the byte budget. UNKNOWN_ARGUMENT/INVALID_ARGUMENT: remove or fix the located member (times are integers, never floats or booleans). TIMED_TEXT_*: the draft breaks the shared contract or budgets. context.purpose: Break each cue of one pinned timed transcript (a machine segments.json or a reviewed/1, /2 or /3 document) into explicit lines of at most maxLineCodePoints Unicode code points and at most maxLines lines, and publish captions.srt, captions.vtt and caption-layout.json. Host-only: whisper-cli is never launched. A break replaces one isolated ordinary space (a run of two or more adjacent spaces is never broken or normalised), so every word, cue index and millisecond is unchanged and joining the lines of a cue with one space restores its text exactly; the source status is carried unchanged and is never promoted.
context.assumptions: A retained timed-text document read by the shared closed validator (at most 4MiB, 512 cues, 256 characters per cue, 32768 in total) and its SHA-256 copied from the document the author reviewed. Cue text may hold runs of adjacent ordinary spaces; they are kept inside an unbreakable run and never normalised. Both bounds are authored: maxLineCodePoints 8 to 80 and maxLines 1 to 3.
context.constraints: Host-only and not native-qualified: no audio, model or recognition run is read or repeated, there is no qualification record for this route, and a transcription receipt does not qualify it. Lengths are Unicode code points of the source text, not grapheme clusters, display width, font metrics or readability. The layout is the fewest lines, then the smallest sum of squared line lengths, then the earliest breaks. An unbreakable run longer than maxLineCodePoints or a cue that needs more than maxLines is refused naming the cue; nothing is split inside a run, truncated, retimed or widened, and a script written without spaces can be refused although it looks narrow. SRT payload is plain text and WebVTT escapes & < > once per line; no cue settings, styles or speaker labels. The review status and language are the source author's declarations; accuracy, readability, accessibility, synchronization and reviewer identity are not verified or certified. Consumers can be stricter: the FFmpeg review movie accepts plain SRT of at most four lines per cue and refuses < > { } and backslash and format characters.
context.inspection: Hold the source bytes, require them to hash to sourceSha256, derive every publication again from those bytes and the authored bounds and compare each file byte for byte: captions.srt, captions.vtt and the canonical caption-layout.json, then check the typed authored document, plan, receipt (runtime host-only, no executable or profile), exact membership (any native launcher, submission, log, link or planted .dispatch content is a failure), the source capture binding and the retained result. Nothing stored is trusted.
context.recovery: LAYOUT_SOURCE_STALE: review the current source and copy its sha256 into sourceSha256. LAYOUT_SOURCE_CHANGED: the source changed while the layout ran; rerun. INVALID_SOURCE: use an absolute local .json regular file of at most 4MiB (no link, device, directory or FIFO). SOURCE_MISSING: the file or a directory on its path does not exist. TIMED_TEXT_*: the source breaks the shared contract or budgets. LAYOUT_WORD_TOO_LONG: raise maxLineCodePoints or correct the unbreakable run (a word, or words joined by a no-break space or by two or more adjacent ordinary spaces). LAYOUT_TOO_MANY_LINES: raise maxLines or maxLineCodePoints. INVALID_ARGUMENT: bounds are integers 8 to 80 and 1 to 3. UNKNOWN_ARGUMENT/MISSING_ARGUMENT: use exactly the declared members. RUNNER_CANCELLED/RUNNER_TIMED_OUT: rerun into a fresh directory. VERIFICATION_FAILED: a retained file differs from independent replay; rerun from the declared input.
